title: Learner Growth, Daily Preparation & Wellbeing Rhythm
description: Personal sanctuary for learners and individuals to plan tomorrow with three gentle things, manage daily study goals, track school timetable periods, and engage in mindful reflection.

intents.title: Prepare Tomorrow Rhythm & Study Priorities
intents.outcome: Capture three gentle prep goals and personal study tasks with fluid tactile interaction.

journeys.title: Manage Tomorrow's Preparation
journeys.situation: In the evening during the wind-down phase, a learner opens Self to set three intentional things to prepare for tomorrow.
journeys.outcome: Goals are captured in local SQLite and swiped complete the next day with tactile haptic feedback.

existingBehavior: TomorrowPrep component renders the Tomorrow Prep list powered by TodoView.
SwipeableTodoRow provides fluid RNGH 3.4 + Reanimated 4 gesture completion.
invariants: Daily prep must remain simple and non-coercive (encouraging 3 gentle things, avoiding overwhelming backlog pressure).
Tasks sync offline-first with zero lag.
openQuestions: How should unfinished prep items carry over to the next morning without guilt framing?

steps.title: Open Self Workspace
steps.interaction: Navigate to the Self tab during evening wind-down.

steps.title: Complete Prep Item
steps.interaction: Swipe right to mark item done.

transitions.title: Focus Prep Input
transitions.feedback: Show clean inline input dressed in active world theme.

transitions.title: Mark Done
transitions.feedback: Green reveal with light haptic tick, strikethrough, and smooth spring layout.

requirements.title: Sensory & Tactile Reinforcement
requirements.statement: Completing a prep item must provide immediate visual spring easing and haptic reinforcement.

bindings.title: Tomorrow Prep Component
bindings.note: Renders modern TodoView for Tomorrow Prep.

scenarios.title: Plan Tomorrow and Complete Next Day
scenarios.expected: Item is created in Tomorrow Prep list and swiped complete smoothly.

intents.title: Navigate Daily Timetable Periods
intents.outcome: View today's schedule, subjects, rooms, and upcoming class periods.

journeys.title: View Daily Class Timetable
journeys.situation: A student needs to know which subject, teacher, and room they should be in during the current period.
journeys.outcome: Current and upcoming class periods are displayed with active period highlighted.
preconditions: Authenticated account is enrolled in at least one active classroom.

existingBehavior: useTimetable loads period schedules with offline cache fallback.
invariants: Timetable periods are cached locally so students in remote classrooms can view their schedule offline.
openQuestions: How should room swaps or substitute teacher notices be indicated dynamically on the period card?

steps.title: View Timetable Periods
steps.interaction: Inspect morning and afternoon period cards.

transitions.title: Inspect Periods
transitions.feedback: Filter and display periods for the selected day.

requirements.title: Offline Schedule Availability
requirements.statement: Class period schedules must be readable even when the device is completely disconnected.

scenarios.title: Check Daily Periods
scenarios.expected: Daily periods are rendered with subject names and room numbers.

intents.title: Engage in Mindful Breathing & Emotional Attunement
intents.outcome: Reset nervous system through guided breathing and record feelings.

journeys.title: Mindful Breathing Reset
journeys.situation: A learner feeling agitated or overwhelmed seeks a quick calming reset.
journeys.outcome: Gentle breath cadence is delivered with sensory haptics and peaceful visuals.
preconditions: App is running in any context.

existingBehavior: BreathGuide component renders expanding/contracting lotus visual.
invariants: Mindful breathing can be cancelled at any second without judgment or penalties.
openQuestions: Should audio bells or binaural audio support be bundled or downloaded on demand?

steps.title: Begin Breathing Exercise
steps.interaction: Tap Lotus breathing button from header or FAB.

transitions.title: Settle into Calm
transitions.action: Complete at least one breath cycle
transitions.feedback: Gentle haptic pulse at turnaround points.

requirements.title: Unforced Calming Motion
requirements.statement: Breathing animation curves must follow sinusoidal natural easing without sudden velocity breaks.

scenarios.title: Calming Reset Session
scenarios.expected: Breathing visual expands and contracts with soothing haptics.

intents.title: Plan, check and look back on my own learning
intents.outcome: The learner gets better at knowing what they know.

journeys.title: Plan, check and look back on an attempt
journeys.situation: A learner opens a quiz or practice set and wants to do better than last time.
journeys.outcome: The learner sees how well their confidence matched their answers and writes what they will do differently.
preconditions: The person has opened Gurudevi on their own device.

invariants: Calibration is never shown to anyone else unless the person shares it.
openQuestions: Who sees calibration: the learner only, or also the teacher in the relation?

steps.title: Choose a first move
steps.interaction: Pick one of three planning prompts, or skip.

steps.title: Say how sure
steps.interaction: Tap a confidence level with each answer.

steps.title: See calibration
steps.interaction: Sure and right, sure and wrong, unsure but right, unsure and wrong.

steps.title: Look back
steps.interaction: Write or record one thing to do differently.

transitions.title: Finish the attempt
transitions.feedback: Calibration groups appear; sure-and-wrong items are offered to the review queue.

transitions.title: Look back
transitions.feedback: The note is kept in the person's journal.

requirements.title: Reflected, never computed
requirements.statement: Whether someone learned or flourished is reflected back to the person, never computed, ranked or predicted by the system; facts are exact, meaning is the person's.

requirements.title: Metacognition made explicit
requirements.statement: Planning, monitoring and evaluating are offered as explicit prompts inside activities, because metacognition must be taught explicitly to have its effect. Project doc claude/learning-that-works.md (evidence, 14 Nov 2026).

bindings.title: Calibration core
bindings.note: confidence and reflected journal steps, calibrationOf (G1).

scenarios.title: Reflect after a class check
scenarios.expected: Calibration is shown only to the learner and stored as their facts, not as a judgment of them.

intents.title: Recognise what I can now do
intents.outcome: The learner sees their own growing competence, in their own words.

journeys.title: Recognise and keep what I can now do
journeys.situation: Help has faded on something the learner used to need hints for, or they learned something outside school.
journeys.outcome: The learner keeps a can-do moment in their own words, with evidence, or lets it pass.
preconditions: The person has opened Gurudevi on their own device.

invariants: Nothing computes a level, rank or prediction.
openQuestions: Default areas offered to students, and their wording in si/ta/en.
Whether guardians see shared moments in Family or messaging.

steps.title: A moment is offered
steps.interaction: See the fact: done alone today, two hints last month. Or tap 'I learned something'.

steps.title: Keep it
steps.interaction: Write it in their own words, choose an area, add a photo or voice note, ask someone to witness.

steps.title: Let it pass
steps.interaction: Dismiss with no mark beyond the offer.

transitions.title: Keep the moment
transitions.feedback: The moment joins the person's areas and the radar.

transitions.title: Let it pass
transitions.feedback: Nothing is recorded about the person; the engine asks less after repeated dismissals.

requirements.title: Only the person claims
requirements.statement: A can-do moment exists only when the person claims or declares it; a witness confirms but never creates one, and outside-syllabus learning counts the same.

requirements.title: Competence made visible
requirements.statement: The learner can see evidence of growing competence, the strongest predictor of self-determined motivation, without a level or score. Project doc claude/learning-that-works.md (evidence, 14 Nov 2026).

bindings.title: Growth subdomain card
bindings.note: Proposed card; L0 encoding is the owner's.

bindings.title: Moments engine
bindings.note: moment:help_faded with consent, caps, quiet hours and dismissal memory (G1).

bindings.title: Person-owned radar
bindings.note: Areas the person chose; self-rating or claimed moments; then and now.

scenarios.title: Keep a moment after help faded
scenarios.expected: The moment is kept in the person's words, and only they can share it.

scenarios.title: Let an offer pass
scenarios.expected: No mark about the person remains; fewer offers follow repeated dismissals.

intents.title: Keep what I learned
intents.outcome: Things learned come back at the right time.

journeys.title: Review what's due, spaced over time
journeys.situation: Items the learner met days or weeks ago are due for review.
journeys.outcome: A short, mixed review brings them back, and each item's next review is scheduled.
preconditions: The person has opened Gurudevi on their own device.

invariants: Schedules are never shown as a score.
openQuestions: Whether review schedules sync to the server or stay on the device.

steps.title: Review offered
steps.interaction: A gentle offer when items are due, at most once a day.

steps.title: Review
steps.interaction: Answer a few items, mixed across topics.

steps.title: Done
steps.interaction: See how many came back easily; nothing is scored.

transitions.title: Start reviewing
transitions.feedback: Due items appear, most overdue first, mixed by topic.

transitions.title: Finish
transitions.feedback: Each item's next review is scheduled from how it went.

requirements.title: Spaced, mixed practice
requirements.statement: Practice comes back over days and weeks and is mixed across topics, because distributed practice and practice testing have the strongest evidence. Project doc claude/learning-that-works.md (evidence, 14 Nov 2026).

bindings.title: Review queue
bindings.note: Grades from the journal and interleaved due items (G1).

scenarios.title: A daily review
scenarios.expected: Due items come back mixed; schedules stay the person's own.
